{{< video videos/nmr_regions.mp4 >}}

All 116 conformers of 2K39, aligned on the core Cα atoms with MDAnalysis before the entity
     is created. The trajectory plays through `mol.play(start, end)` while the camera moves onto
     the painted helix and then the painted tail, and the representation cuts to ball-and-stick.

     ProteinMotion surrounds the regions with sphere, box and atom highlights; those wait on a
     `Style Highlight` node.

After ProteinMotion's [`nmr_regions.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/nmr_regions.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/nmr_regions.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/nmr_regions.py"}
{{< include scripts/nmr_regions.py >}}
```
